text: Blue Beard’s more in my line, and him I like best when he turned into the pantaloon.” “I’m all for making a policeman into sausages,” said John Crook. “It’s a better definition of Socialism than some recently given. But surely the get-up would be too big a business.” “Not a scrap,” cried Blount, quite carried away. “A harlequinade’s the quickest thing we can do, for two reasons. First, one can gag to any degree; and, second, all the objects are household things--tables and towel-horses and washing baskets, and things like that.” “That’s true,” admitted Crook, nodding eagerly and walking about.
